integrations.appScope: Bring results from NimiGo into NimiDay
integrations.checklistMeetup: Confirm the meetup time and place
integrations.mcpScope: Read information from authorized sources in NimiDay, select what you need, and save it quickly.
integrations.messagingScope: Choose which platforms to connect and grant messaging permissions to apps as needed.

security.accessDetail: Access depends on the app’s declared permissions and the current protected session.
security.checkDetail: In text.generate, the check looks only for supported, complete, unencrypted PEM private keys and GitHub classic personal access token (PAT) formats.
security.request: Help me inspect this connection log.
security.ready: Edit the example request to explore the content-check flow.
security.refused: The example input was blocked. Your draft is preserved for you to edit and try again.
security.editNote: Your draft is preserved. Edit it to try the demo again.
security.sent: The example flow is complete. Nothing was sent to a model.
security.scope: Inputs · Output as it’s generated · Complete tool arguments
security.limit: Once displayed, text cannot be recalled. Images, audio, video, and arbitrary encodings are out of scope. This is not comprehensive leak prevention, and it does not detect prompt injection.
security.note: Content checks are a developer preview in current source builds. See release notes for packaged availability.
security.noSandbox: These boundaries cover Nimi-managed calls, not the entire operating system or every action an app can take.
builder.title: Build your own AI app
builder.body: Add AI with the SDK, choose the Kit components you need, and use App Tools to create, debug, and package your app.

experience.continuityBody: Pick up the conversation with the same companion and its existing memories in supported apps you’ve authorized. Try sending a message in the demo, then switch views to see it there.
experience.memoryNote: You can edit or remove the sample memory. The original conversation stays available.
experience.scope: Each app stores its data separately. When you use cloud AI, Nimi sends the input and context the request needs to the provider you choose.
